request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Sootveil Bat".

Creative brief
Name: Sootveil Bat
Collection: Ashforge Remnants. Abandoned forge creatures and half-living constructs powered by coals, slag, chains, soot, and unstable furnace heat.
Core concept: A fast aerial enemy that hides its next shot angle inside a visible smoke trail.
Body and silhouette: Small bat with oversized triangular wings, pointed ears, and a compact ember body.
Signature features: Soot-cloud wing edges, glowing mouth, and thin copper wing braces.
Palette and materials: Soot black, smoke gray, dull copper, and ember yellow.
Movement personality: Erratic, fluttering, and evasive.
Attack concept: Flies in a short arc, leaving a dark smoke curve, then sends sparks traveling back along that exact curve.
Directional details: The right ear is capped with a small copper band.
Avoid: Vampire humanoid, invisible dark-on-dark silhouette, realistic membrane detail.
